defs.def: extremely clever or impressive 巧妙的；使人印象深的

ex.s: Not a brilliant idea, but funny; and unlikely to be anyone else’s choice.
ex.t: 不是个绝妙的主意，但很有趣；而且不太可能是别人的选择。

ex.s: Not a brilliant idea, but funny; and unlikely to be anyone else’s choice.
ex.t: 不是个绝妙的主意，但很有趣；而且不太可能是别人的选择。

ex.s: Brilliant though it is, Project Debater has some weaknesses.
ex.t: 尽管"辩论手项目"非常出色，但它也有一些弱点。

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: In looking into the stories of biological discovery, I also began to find something else, a collection of scientists, usually brilliant occasionally half-mad, who made the discoveries.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉也开始填满了，当它填满时我在想是否还有更大的发现，不仅仅是物种，还有依赖于被认为无用的东西的生命，甚至是没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: How did those brilliant scientists make great discoveries?
ex.t: 那些才华横溢的科学家是如何做出重大发现的？

ex.s: As a shy person, working from home, hiding behind my computer was brilliant.
ex.t: 作为一个害羞的人，在家工作、躲在电脑后面棒极了。

ex.s: There was a bit of me that didn't want to love this when everyone else on the planet did but the horror story is brilliant.
ex.t: 当地球上其他人都喜爱这本书时，我心里有一点不想爱上它，但这本恐怖小说太精彩了。

ex.s: Always I am mistaken for Professor Einstein!” On 18 April 1955, it was reported that Einstein had passed away, and the whole world mourned the great loss of a brilliant scientist.
ex.t: “我总是被误认为是爱因斯坦教授！”1955年4月18日，据报道爱因斯坦逝世，全世界都为失去这位卓越的科学家而哀悼。

ex.s: Besides being brilliant, he was brave, though sometimes careless in what he said or did.
ex.t: 除了才华出众，他还很勇敢，尽管有时言行粗心。

ex.s: It's a brilliant for students is that they need to make idea to proper judgements...
ex.t: 对学生而言，一个妙处是：他们需要作出恰当的判断……

defs.def: very intelligent or skilful 聪颖的；技艺高的
very good; excellent 很好的；杰出的

ex.s: If you are looking for the best comedies on tour and brilliant live music, you should start here.
ex.t: 如果你在寻找最好的巡演喜剧和精彩的现场音乐，你应该从这里开始。

ex.s: A Chinese Master Zhang Daqian, born in 1899 in Sichuan Province, was one of China's most brilliant and popular artists.
ex.t: 中国画大师张大千，1899年生于四川，是中国最杰出、最受欢迎的艺术家之一。
